reference.basis: Independent paraxial calculation from Table 1 and SCHOTT Sellmeier coefficients at 0.55 um; F-number uses Table 2's 41.5 mm nominal entrance pupil

entries.glass: SCHOTT N-BK7, N-KZFS5, N-SK2 and N-SF5 named in Table 1; no further substitution.
entries.adaptations: Preserve Table 1 radii, gaps, stop position, and image plane. Select Table 2's central wavelength as primary. Use its nominal entrance pupil, not a pupil derived from the physical stop. Clear apertures, annuli, and field-dependent pupil shifts are not in the sequential model.

entries.glass: ZMX model glass (___BLANK) with Table 1 nd and Vd, no catalog matching.
entries.adaptations: Use the infinity configuration only. Entrance pupil diameter = 41.2/2.89 mm, since the table does not give a stop diameter. Table 1 leaves Bf symbolic; set the image plane at the paraxial d-line back focal distance calculated from the tabulated radii, gaps and nd (56.49949990 mm). Sample axis and the published 72 degree full field's edge.
